data.narrative:
Skyrora is a private-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $66M to date. The addressable peer set comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard valuation triangulation methods face material constraints. Peer-median analysis is not applicable: while 14 same-sector private peers exist, fewer than three datapoints meet narrow filters for stage, adjacency, or valuation tier, and relying on broader sector medians would obscure meaningful differences in business model and maturity. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is similarly inapplicable because Skyrora's revenue is not disclosed; the Space & Aerospace sector median P/S across the 6 public tickers is 26.4x, but applying this multiple requires revenue data not available for private companies.

The analysis cannot support a specific valuation range given current data constraints. A meaningful valuation would require either (1) disclosed or estimated revenue enabling P/S anchoring to the 26.4x sector median, (2) sufficient private comparables at matching stage and scale to establish peer median multiples on EBITDA or similar metrics, or (3) bottom-up discounted cash flow analysis. The primary uncertainty is Skyrora's revenue trajectory and near-term profitability path relative to the heterogeneous peer set spanning launch, imagery, and in-orbit services.
